name: TW Nor
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 10.79 days; its mean radius is 73 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, TW Nor: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 73 +/- 6.4 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 183, Name='TW Nor', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5000 +/- 204 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, TW Nor: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2293.8 +/- 205.6 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 1.157 +/- 0.013 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 73 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 10.8 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 73 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 2,294 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, TW Nor: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 5981406000300438016 (quality A), from 2012ApJ...748..107P; Gaia DR3 measures none
